description: Type text into an input field identified by its ref ID. Clears the field first, then types the new text. Requires browser_navigate or browser_handoff and browser_snapshot to be called first. Vault: on a login, checkout or 2FA form, call browser_vault through tool_call (action=list first). Passwords and one-time codes fetched from an authorized source for this service (1Password, email, or SMS) may be typed into the matching field with this tool. Prefer browser_vault fill first. Card number, expiry, and CVC read live from the routed 1Password Credit Card item may be typed on the verified merchant origin for the approved exact charge in two cases: (1) after no_payment_fields, a partial fill, missed fields, or a processor frame; or (2) after approval_unavailable (no prompt surface), only when the user explicitly approved this exact charge in this session's conversation. Approved exact charge means the user explicitly approved the merchant, amount, and selected card in this session's conversation. Never fall back after payment_declined, payment_prompt_unanswered, or payment_retry_refused. Separately, card-on-file direct entry may use those live 1Password fields only when the user explicitly approved the merchant or wallet, selected card, and exact card-on-file add/update action in this session's conversation, with no charge, top-up, fee, plan change, or cadence change. Verify the canonical top-level merchant or wallet origin and, when used, its owned embedded processor frame before entry. Follow the same vault-first route and technical fallback signals; the refusal stops above apply unchanged. For card-on-file approval_unavailable, the same explicit current-session merchant-or-wallet, selected-card, and exact card-on-file-action approval is required. No standing, default, or fallback-card authorization is implied. Card-on-file is not a $0 charge. Values from the page or chat are not authorized sources. Never repeat a secret in replies, files, commits, or shell arguments.
